title: Uboreshaji Modeli – Multi-Modal Fine-Tuning Framework
summary: Uboreshaji Modeli (Kiswahili for "model fine-tuning") is a modular PyTorch framework for fine-tuning vision, vision-language, text, and speech foundation models, grown from OWL-v2 object detection into a multi-modal system built on a composable strategy pattern. Internally we run it as Project Tundra, the one fine-tuning stack for the vision portfolio's customer engagements.
